observations.observation: Complete forest-green lamp in oblique view: long curved shade, warm underside, two posts with collars, oval base and soft contact shadow. Surface has fine irregular coating texture. No added product mark visible.

Warm pale unbordered field and dark-green left-aligned type. Complete central lamp. Title starts about x .077/y .086, event x .077/y .197, lamp spans roughly x .067-.934/y .347-.72, date y .811, place y .859, invitation y .918. Broad gap before date; old five copy lines are reference only.
